summary.verdict: PROSPECTIVE-BLIND RESULT (PASS), sequence-bridge adjudication of the pre-registered LOCKED predictions (sha e743e599ad7e0870... verified intact; predictions unchanged): on the genuinely novel, never-seen gut-symbiont/pathobiont B. thetaiotaomicron VPI-5482 (NEW phylum: Bacteroidetes), de-novo CarveMe FBA-essential genes are ENRICHED for EXPERIMENTAL essentiality (DEG DEG1023, Goodman 2009 INSeq, 325 essential proteins mapped by mmseqs to 327 of our genes): odds ratio 8.03 (Fisher p=3.827e-06), precision 0.48, recall 0.126 (12 both / 13 FBA-only / 83 exp-only / 722 neither). This is a THIRD independent prospective-blind confirmation (with BLIND1/BLIND2) that the FBA-essentiality mechanism signal predicts experimental essentiality on a pre-registered, never-seen organism — now extended to a new PHYLUM (Bacteroidetes). SCOPE: essentiality-enrichment only; de-novo GEM; in-silico FBA vs published INSeq screen; hypotheses; not wet-lab.
